raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A bare launch of a 1M-context model can OOM while building the KV pools. Reproduced on 1x H200 with `thinkingmachines/Inkling` (`test` revision, `context_len=1048576`) and no flags:

```
torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.30 GiB. ... of which 2.08 GiB is free.
```

`_profile_available_bytes` sizes the pre-capture KV budget as `free - slack - mamba state`, and the KV pools then consume all of it. The `req_to_token` table is never charged, so it silently lives in the slack. The slack (`pre_model_load * (1 - mem_fraction_static)`) is meant for activations and CUDA graph buffers (see `handle_gpu_memory_settings`). That only works while the table is small:

| | rows x context x 4 B | slack at 0.903 on H200 |
|---|---|---|
| 40K-context model | 4097 x 40964 x 4 = 0.6 GiB | 13.5 GB |
| Inkling (1M context) | 4097 x 1048580 x 4 = 16 GiB | 13.5 GB |

Measured around pool construction for that run: the req pool step takes 27.07 GiB (mamba 11.05 + `req_to_token` 16.02). Full KV (92.1 GiB) then fits, but SWA (18.4 GiB) does not. With KV sizes unchanged, either `--max-running-requests 256` or `--context-length 131072` alone gets past pool construction, which confirms the cause.

## Modifications

- `_profile_available_bytes` subtracts an upper bound of the `req_to_token` table before the mamba/KV split, the same way the mamba state pool is already charged. The upper bound is `(max running requests per DP worker, or the 4096 auto-estimate cap) + decode pre-alloc rows + 1 padding row`, times `(context_len + extra) x int32`.
- The post-capture KV sizing path is unchanged: it measures free memory after the table already exists.
- Extract `MAX_AUTO_RUNNING_REQUESTS_PER_WORKER` (shared with `resolve_max_num_reqs`) and `_decode_req_pool_pre_alloc_size()` (shared with `_build_req_to_token_pool`, behavior unchanged).
- `TestReqToTokenBudget` in `test_pool_configurator.py` (CPU): builds the real pool from the `max_num_reqs` that `resolve_max_num_reqs` returns, and asserts that the reserved bound covers its `req_to_token.nbytes` (PD decode with pre-alloc rows; auto-sized and per-DP-worker requests; small and large token capacity). The test turns red if the bound drops the pre-alloc rows, drops the padding row, or if `resolve_max_num_reqs` is allowed past the 4096 cap.

Trade-off: every model's pre-capture KV capacity shrinks by the table size, memory the table was already taking from the activation slack. When `--max-running-requests` is unset, the bound uses the 4096 cap even where the auto-estimate resolves lower, so it is conservative by at most that difference.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change; only the pool sizes move.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

1x H200, no flags except the model path:

| model | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Inkling `test` (1M context) | OOM building the SWA pool | pools built, 13.01 GB free after `Memory pool end`; with #35292 also applied, boots and serves |
| Qwen3-0.6B (40K context) | 1,165,058 KV tokens, 12.83 GB free | 1,159,205 KV tokens (-0.50%), 13.38 GB free |

Unit suites `test/registered/unit/mem_cache`, `test/registered/unit/model_executor`, and `test/registered/unit/test_runtime_context.py` fail the same tests on main and on this PR (`test_unified_hicache_transfer_lifecycle` 4 failed + 4 errors, `test_unified_mha_views` 1 failed, all pre-existing). The only difference is the new test passing.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -216,6 +216,7 @@ def mm_runtime_reservation_gb(
 MAMBA_CACHE_SIZE_MAX_RUNNING_REQUESTS_RATIO = 3
 MAMBA_CACHE_BASE_RATIO_DROP_ON_SKIP = 1
 MAMBA_CACHE_V2_ADDITIONAL_RATIO_NO_BUFFER = 1
+MAX_AUTO_RUNNING_REQUESTS_PER_WORKER = 4096
 
 
 def _pp_local_per_request_bytes(
@@ -1387,16 +1388,24 @@ def _validate_prefill_only_disable_kv_cache_pool_family(
                 "attention, no HiSparse, and --kv-cache-dtype not in {nvfp4, fp4_mx_block16}."
             )
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _decode_req_pool_pre_alloc_size() -> Optional[int]:
+        """Extra pre-allocated rows of the decode-shaped pool; None for a plain pool."""
+        disagg = get_disagg()
+        if disagg.disaggregation_mode != "decode" and not disagg.enable_pd_role_switch:
+            return None
+        # A flip-capable prefill needs the decode pool shape, and the extra-slot
+        # default is only computed for a decode launch.
+        pre_alloc_size = disagg.disaggregation_decode_extra_slots
+        if disagg.enable_pd_role_switch:
+            pre_alloc_size = pre_alloc_size or 0
+        return pre_alloc_size
+
     def _build_req_to_token_pool(self, *, max_num_reqs: int) -> ReqToTokenPool:
         extra_max_context_len = get_req_to_token_extra_context_len()
 
-        disagg = get_disagg()
-        if disagg.disaggregation_mode == "decode" or disagg.enable_pd_role_switch:
-            # A flip-capable prefill needs the decode pool shape, and the extra-slot
-            # default is only computed for a decode launch.
-            pre_alloc_size = disagg.disaggregation_decode_extra_slots
-            if disagg.enable_pd_role_switch:
-                pre_alloc_size = pre_alloc_size or 0
+        pre_alloc_size = self._decode_req_pool_pre_alloc_size()
+        if pre_alloc_size is not None:
             if self.mambaish_config:
                 return self._build_hybrid_mamba_decode_req_pool(
                     max_num_reqs=max_num_reqs,
@@ -2695,7 +2704,11 @@ def _profile_available_bytes(self, pre_model_load_memory: int) -> int:
             is_multimodal=self.model_config.is_multimodal,
             mm_feature_transport=get_mm().mm_feature_transport,
         )
-        rest_memory = available_gpu_memory - slack_gb - mm_reservation_gb
+        # The req_to_token table is allocated beside the KV pools, not out of the slack.
+        req_to_token_gb = self._req_to_token_pool_bytes_upper_bound() / (1 << 30)
+        rest_memory = (
+            available_gpu_memory - slack_gb - mm_reservation_gb - req_to_token_gb
+        )
         if self.mambaish_config is not None:
             rest_memory = self._handle_max_mamba_cache(rest_memory)
 
@@ -2719,6 +2732,21 @@ def _profile_available_bytes(self, pre_model_load_memory: int) -> int:
 
         return int(rest_memory * (1 << 30))  # return in bytes
 
+    def _req_to_token_pool_bytes_upper_bound(self) -> int:
+        """Largest req_to_token table _build_req_to_token_pool can allocate."""
+        requested = get_schedule().max_running_requests
+        max_num_reqs = (
+            requested // self.attn_dp_size
+            if requested is not None
+            else MAX_AUTO_RUNNING_REQUESTS_PER_WORKER
+        )
+        pre_alloc_size = self._decode_req_pool_pre_alloc_size() or 0
+        num_rows = max_num_reqs + pre_alloc_size + 1  # +1: padding row 0
+        max_context_len = (
+            self.model_config.context_len + get_req_to_token_extra_context_len()
+        )
+        return num_rows * max_context_len * torch.int32.itemsize
+
     def _calculate_mamba_ratio(self) -> int:
         if get_memory().disable_radix_cache:
             return 1
@@ -2781,7 +2809,7 @@ def resolve_max_num_reqs(self, token_capacity: int) -> int:
         token capacity."""
         # Estimate pool size (used as upper bound when user specifies max_running_requests)
         estimated = int(token_capacity / self.model_config.context_len * 512)
-        estimated = max(min(estimated, 4096), 2048)
+        estimated = max(min(estimated, MAX_AUTO_RUNNING_REQUESTS_PER_WORKER), 2048)
 
         max_num_reqs = get_schedule().max_running_requests
         if max_num_reqs is not None:

@@ -1203,6 +1203,38 @@ def _tokens(draft_kv_per_token):
         self.assertLess(_tokens(10240), _tokens(None))
 
 
+class TestReqToTokenBudget(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_budget_covers_every_req_to_token_pool_resolve_can_build(self):
+        """The pre-capture KV budget reserves a req_to_token bound; a larger pool OOMs."""
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_cache_configurator import KVCacheConfigurator
+
+        for max_running_requests, attn_dp_size in ((None, 1), (64, 2)):
+            for token_capacity in (1 << 12, 1 << 30):
+                with self.subTest(
+                    max_running_requests=max_running_requests,
+                    attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size,
+                    token_capacity=token_capacity,
+                ):
+                    mr = _make_model_runner(
+                        self,
+                        disaggregation_mode="decode",
+                        disaggregation_decode_extra_slots=24,
+                        max_running_requests=max_running_requests,
+                    )
+                    kvc = object.__new__(KVCacheConfigurator)
+                    kvc.model_config = mr.model_config
+                    kvc.attn_dp_size = attn_dp_size
+                    kvc.mambaish_config = None
+                    kvc.device = "cpu"
+                    pool = kvc._build_req_to_token_pool(
+                        max_num_reqs=kvc.resolve_max_num_reqs(token_capacity)
+                    )
+                    self.assertGreaterEqual(
+                        kvc._req_to_token_pool_bytes_upper_bound(),
+                        pool.req_to_token.nbytes,
+                    )
+
+
 class TestSWAPoolFloor(CustomTestCase):
     """An SWA pool below the prefill admission floor must fail here, not livelock
     the scheduler at warmup."""
